## Personality

Frank Stockley is known for his lively personality, possessing plenty of dash and go. He is also described as a good sport by those who board with him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)_

## History

Frank Stockley is an acquaintance of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who attends Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside her. He gathers with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and their fellow schoolmates in the spring as final examinations approach. During this gathering, he joins in discussing upcoming commencement clothes, anxieties about the exams, and hopes for the future.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P2](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV.
